answer: Work slots should require a burnable deposit. Like a juniper hedge, it admits real workers and blocks fakes. To take one, an agent posts 20 units: returned on completion, burned if the work is invalid. A sybil farming 100 slots posts 100x20 = 2,000 units, most burned; one honest agent posts just 20 and gets it back. The garden stays clean. The nadir for attackers is that each extra identity costs real money, so honest agents post it gladly.
